line_items.reasoning: FAST delivered 11.7% YoY sales growth in Q3 2025, clearly achieving the double-digit growth management expressed confidence in for H2 2025, with the strongest daily sales rate since Q1 2023.
Gross margin expanded 40 bps YoY to 45.3%, beating the guidance of full-year gross margin remaining essentially flat with 2024, despite the acknowledged price/cost headwind in H2.
No Q3-specific capex figures were reported in the current results, and the full-year $250M–$270M guidance was not revised or contradicted, so it is treated as on track.
Pricing contribution came in at only 240–270 bps in Q3, falling short of the guided 3%–5% target for Q3, and the Q4 goal was also revised down to 3.5%–5.5% from the prior 5%–8%.

The installed FMI device base grew 8.7% YoY to ~134,000 devices with strong digital sales growth, but no explicit Q3 MEU signing count was reported to confirm or deny progress toward the 25,000–26,000 full-year target.
